aggregate.name: Goal
aggregate.progressHealthSeparation: AT_RISK is a legacy progress-health or projection value, not a canonical Goal lifecycle state and never an event state.
aggregate.automaticCompletionRule: Progress reaching 100 percent does not transition ACTIVE to COMPLETED.

commandContracts.ifMatchSemantics: The newly sealed create absent-version CAS is the strong literal "0". The server creates goalId before receipt reservation and rejects any nonzero or weak validator.
commandContracts.weightRule: Decimal arithmetic only; create validates the individual value in [0,1]. It does not require the owner-group total to be complete at draft creation.

commandContracts.ifMatchSemantics: Strong ETag of the current aggregateVersion; weak, absent and stale validators fail closed.
commandContracts.groupWeightGuard: Submit locks and reads the transaction-consistent current non-cancelled Goal revisions for the same tenant, cycleVersionId, ownerType and ownerPublicId; their decimal weights must total exactly 1.000000.
commandContracts.revisionSemantics: Submit does not append or modify a content revision. It preserves current revisionNo and contentHash and changes only goalState plus aggregateVersion under CAS. Editing returned content requires a separately authorized revise command.

publicGoalResponse.receiptLinkDecision: The Goal body remains unchanged. The newly sealed X-DWP-Command-Receipt-Id response header exposes the durable receipt locator for first success and exact replay.
publicGoalResponse.replayRule: Same idempotency key and same frozen request digest returns the original status, Goal body, ETag, receipt locator and correlation metadata without a new effect.
publicGoalResponse.resultUnknownRule: A stable problem response includes X-DWP-Command-Receipt-Id when the durable receipt is RESULT_UNKNOWN; the client polls the receipt and must not retry with a new key.

idempotencyAndReceipt.reserveOrder: Reserve and compare the trusted-tenant receipt before any business effect or dynamic re-resolution.

receiptQuery.authorization: Apply the more restrictive of originating-command and current authorization; tenant, subject or population mismatch returns opaque 404.

eventContract.atomicity: Create inserts Goal plus immutable revisionNo 1; submit references the existing immutable revision without inserting or changing it. Each command commits its aggregate mutation, SUCCEEDED receipt and exactly one outbox row in one transaction.
eventContract.replay: Idempotent replay emits zero additional events.
eventContract.delivery: Broker delivery is at least once; consumers deduplicate by trusted tenant and eventId and quarantine payload-hash mismatch.

acceptanceConditions.criterion: The exact browser and owner POST paths require Idempotency-Key and strong If-Match, accept closed requests, return 201 or 200 with the closed Goal body, and return ETag, X-DWP-Command-Receipt-Id, correlation and private no-store headers.
verificationTargets: generated transport and authorization contract test

acceptanceConditions.criterion: The seven-state Goal matrix is identical in code, public API and database; RETURNED is present, AT_RISK is excluded from lifecycle state, and PER-009 owns only create and submit.

Create validates trusted tenant, active cycle version, owner identity and population, period bounds, closed measurement schema, individual decimal weight in [0,1] and absent-version CAS, then creates revisionNo 1 without requiring the group total or accepting caller tenant or authority fields.

Submit accepts only DRAFT or RETURNED with a current strong ETag, validates the transaction-consistent owner-group weight total as exactly 1.000000, preserves the existing revisionNo and contentHash without appending a revision, increments aggregateVersion exactly once and leaves no partial effect on stale or illegal transitions.

APP.HCM:VIEW plus exact profile, duty, capability, population, field and purpose checks guard both commands; SELF equality and assigned-manager population are enforced and cross-tenant or out-of-population targets are opaque 404.
verificationTargets: SELF and manager population matrix test

acceptanceConditions.criterion: The receipt is reserved before effects; same key and frozen digest replays exactly, key or authorization-context mismatch is 409, and concurrent duplicates create one aggregate effect and one event.

RESULT_UNKNOWN always exposes the original receipt locator, supports authorized polling and recovery, preserves closed receipt transitions and applies originating versus current more-restrictive authority with opaque 404 mismatch handling.

Create atomically inserts Goal and immutable revisionNo 1 with receipt and minimized outbox; submit atomically updates only state and aggregateVersion while referencing the existing revision with receipt and outbox. Rollback, retry, duplicate delivery and crash recovery preserve one committed business effect and consumer deduplication.

Only the exact Goal owner schema is added with tenant-first keys, FORCE and ENABLE RLS, PUBLIC revoke and least privilege; V1 through V20 remain immutable, V9 is forbidden and V21 exists only under a separate allocator lease.

The legacy personal-goal read and progress adapter preserves scope replacement, late-response rejection, 403 fail-closed, 409 rebase, provenance, private caching and no automatic completion while canonical create and submit introduce no dual read or dual write.

PEP-PER-001 and PEP-PER-002 are reused, IAQ-038 and team-performance remain owned by PER-008, action provenance grants no command authority, and the existing receipt query remains BASE-TFR-PER-011 without completion recount.

Delta-only frontend and backend tests cover loading, empty, denied, conflict, result-unknown, replay, accessibility and responsive states; default OFF produces zero calls and no route, menu, tenant activation, end-to-end or full-HRIS completion claim is made.
